verdicts.reason: Version A splits parsing and summarising into small, single-purpose, independently testable helpers (parsePath, parseStatus, p95, topPaths, timeBounds), whereas B packs all aggregation into one long Analyze and all field validation into one long parseLine, making each harder to read and change safely.

Version B separates parsing from summarizing and splits each field and statistic into a small, independently testable, well-named helper, whereas Version A mixes parsing, aggregation, sorting and percentile logic into one long Analyze loop.
